Sure! The easiest way to coordinate the key handover is WhatsApp: +351 913 870 226 (Rita, the host's sister). Send her a message when you leave the airport.

The hold is released at check-out, but depending on your bank it can take 5-10 working days to disappear from your statement.

Dear Mr Okafor, thank you for choosing us for your conference. As requested, the invoice for the meeting room and coffee breaks (€1,240) will be sent by our accounting department from accounts@hotelparkview-leeds.co.uk. You can pay by bank transfer within 30 days of the event or by card at check-out, whichever suits your company.

Dear guest, your booking was made with a non-refundable rate, which Booking.com has charged on the booking date. If you see two transactions on your statement, one may be a temporary authorisation by your bank that will disappear in a few days. Please contact Booking.com customer service if it doesn't.

Hello and welcome! Just a heads-up so there are no surprises: Amsterdam tourist tax (12.5% of the room price) is charged at check-out together with the rest of your stay. You don't need to pay anything before you arrive.

Please do this directly in the app or on the Booking.com website. If the card is not updated, the platform may cancel the reservation according to its policy. Let us know if you have any questions.
No problem at all! We saw that you updated the card in the app, everything is fine now. Nothing will be charged before your arrival; you will pay at reception when you check in.

Le recordamos que nunca le pediremos los datos de la tarjeta por este chat ni por teléfono. No se realizará ningún cargo antes de su llegada.

Dear guest, please note we do not take any payment before arrival. If you ever receive a message asking you to pay via a link or bank transfer for this reservation, please do not pay and contact us by phone using the number on our official website.

If you prefer to pay everything on arrival, that is also fine, just let us know.

Dear guest, a refundable damage deposit of €200 is required for this apartment. It is collected by Booking.com as part of your reservation and will be refunded automatically within 7 days after check-out, provided there is no damage.
